messages:
tanya: quick heads-up 1: web4re piloting a small voucher program for parents on the infant daycare waitlist who are returning from parental leave early or with phased schedules. hoping to reduce last-minute childcare gaps. anyone directly affected or curious?
kevin: hey -- ib4m coming back next month and our preferred daycare still has a 6-week wait. what does the voucher cover?
people-ops-bot: Pilot doc (internal): https://intranet.redwood.example/hr/infant-voucher-pilot - eligibility, caps, and sign-up form.
natalie: hi kevin 1: details: vouchers cover up to $300/week for up to 6 weeks while on an official waitlist OR until enrollment starts, whichever comes first. must be used with an approved provider (licensed center or registered in-home).
kevin: sounds helpful. do we need manager sign-off to qualify?
ali: manager here 1: yes please cc your manager on the form. web4ll confirm your phased return dates so we can sync coverage with team schedule.
tanya: also note: vouchers are post-pay reimbursements unless you request an advance on the form. advances require payroll lead time so plan at least two pay cycles out.
kevin: whatb4s the difference between this and the backup-care stipend? seems similar.
natalie: good q. voucher pilot is specifically for enrolled waitlist situations for infants (0-12 months) while youb4re returning to work. backup-care stipend is for short-term emergency coverage and travel nights; voucher is for bridging long lead-time enrollment.
kevin: got it. international employees? ib4m in the EU office.
tanya: international employees are eligible but amounts/allowed provider types vary by country. fill the form and indicate your country; people-ops will follow up with country-specific guidance and tax implications.
atalie: also: to apply you need to provide the daycare waitlist confirmation email and proof of payment for any voucher reimbursement. if youb4re using an in-home provider, please attach business registration or insurance docs.
kevin: timeline: if i apply today, when would reimbursement arrive?
tanya: reimbursements processed via Expensify weekly run; expect 7-14 days after web4re sent receipts. if you requested an advance, allow payroll processing time (2 pay cycles).
kevin: is there a cap per family? we have twins so cost doubles :)
natalie: candidly, pilot cap per family is $1,200 total across the 6-week period (so $300/week cap still applies). web4re tracking usage; if many twin families apply web4ll revise and let folks know.
kevin: fair enough. last q 1: does taking a voucher affect parental leave pay or benefits?
ali: no - vouchers are an operational benefit and do not reduce leave pay or parental top-up. they are handled separately as a childcare bridging benefit.
atalie: one more thing: web4re limiting the pilot to 40 families globally. sign-ups are first-come-first-serve; web4ll prioritize folks within 8 weeks of return date.
tanya: TL;DR: fill the voucher form, attach waitlist proof, cc your manager, choose advance if needed. people-ops will respond within 3 business days.
kevin: thanks all 1: filling the form now.
people-ops-bot: Form link: https://intranet.redwood.example/hr/forms/infant-voucher-signup (internal)
